data.title: 萝丝 · 暴风雪隘口的亡命逆旅
data.description: 狂风撕扯的奥利安娜边境雪山险隘中，暴雪茫茫。身披破损斗篷的萝丝双手按剑伫立在断崖冰道上，风雪沾湿金发，眼神孤绝刚毅。
data.location: windswept frozen alpine mountain pass with jagged ice crags and heavy snowdrifts
data.action: standing firmly on a blizzard-blown cliff trail, tattered traveler cloak whipping behind her, hand on rapier hilt, unyielding fierce golden eyes
data.lighting: 风雪漫射冷白光与灰暗天光
data.promptProse: Rose in a weathered tattered cloak braves a howling mountain blizzard on a cliff edge, gripping her rapier hilt with unbreakable resolve.
data.animaCaption: Heavy snow whips through her frayed cloak as she stands guard over the frozen pass.
